snippet.title: The Flash Video Game
snippet.description: This is early game footage from the unfinished Flash video game made by Bottlerocket Entertainment in 2008.  When our publisher Brash folded we were about 6 months into full production with about a year still to go on the game so please excuse the roughness of how it looks at this stage.  A lot of the core elements were just starting to surface and we were all really saddened that the game couldn't be saved.  It was showing much potential.  As such we just wanted to share a sample of what the game could have been like.  Enjoy!
